description: UMW TCA9555 — I2C 16-bit I/O expander, 1.65-5.5V, configurable polarity inversion. TSSOP-24 package. Pin-compatible with PCA9555. Each pin 25mA sink/source.
name: tca9555
watch_out_for: 16ch I2C IO expander: addr via A0-A2 (0x20-0x27); INT is open-drain (pull-up); inputs default high-impedance with weak pull-ups.
